task_text: Press the red button on the instrument's front panel (the two grey buttons next to it do not count) and keep it pressed. Success the moment its cap has been pushed in more than 5 mm for one second (60 control steps in a row). The panel is vertical and faces the arm: the button is pushed in along the forward (+x) axis of the arm's base.

inventory: instrument with a vertical front panel
red square button, 8 cm across (the target)
two dark grey square buttons, 8 cm across
